# Les Paul Anatomy

> An interactive, photoreal 3D anatomy of a Gibson Les Paul Custom “Black Beauty.” Thirty-one parts, each named and explained, plus a guided signal path from the strings to the amplifier.

## What it covers

- The gloss-black body, carved maple top, cream multi-ply binding, black pickguard, and control cavity.
- The set neck, ebony fretboard with pearl block inlays, frets, nut, bound headstock with split-diamond inlay, gold tuners, and truss rod cover.
- The gold-covered humbuckers, pole pieces, selector, black-and-gold volume and tone knobs, and gold output jack.
- The gold Tune-o-matic bridge, stopbar tailpiece, strings, poker chip, and strap buttons.

## Signal path

Strings → neck pickup → bridge pickup → selector switch → volume → tone → output jack → amplifier.
